name: Fantasy Sekai de Atta Kowai Hanashi
original_name: ファンタジー世界であった怖い話
source:
As a fledgling adventurer, you can use it as a reference for your future adventures.
Three senior adventurers talk about "the scary adventures they have ever experienced"
I will listen.
The rugged knight Basil. Bullish female swordfighter Civil. A serious monk Henry.
What kind of scary story will the three tell in the world of swords and magic?

[From [url=https://www.freem.ne.jp/win/game/25660]Freem![/url]]
